testsuite.name: io.libp2p.mux.yamux.YamuxOutboundBufferBudgetRefCountTest

testcase.name: inbound data is released when window update budget rejection closes connection()
budget rejection releases retained outbound slices that were not written()
budget close fails undelivered in-flight parent write futures()
